body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 9962284194f4ef4832c3bc479100ab94b8fc765b -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Note on the stack: #482 is already in `upstream/main`, so against current main this PR's own diff is five files (`fixture_rows.rs`, `pages.rs`, `egui_app/mod.rs`, `tests.rs`, `tests/fixture_rows.rs`). I reviewed those.

**What looks good**
- Every verb still goes through the existing undoable commands (`MoveFixture`, `SetFixtureFixed`, `UntagFixture`, `DeleteFixture`) in `fixture_rows.rs`. The place form is view state only, so it adds no undo step.
- The Place X/Y/Z/yaw fields are labelled and `Apply` is the only path to `MoveFixture`.
- No `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic` or unchecked indexing or casts. The new module has a provenance line and is 108 lines. `pages.rs` shrinks, though at 1858 lines it is still over the 400-line guide (not blocking).
- The new test `fixture_rows_fit_the_default_pane_and_label_the_place_fields` pins the layout, and the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #509`.

**Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 372 passed, 3 failed, 5 ignored |
| `fixture_rows` test | passes |
| `camcraft-ui --test fixtures` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The 3 failures are `headless_run_succeeds` (the known headless-GPU failure) and `structural::shell_structure_light` / `shell_structure_dark`. The structural ones fail on the toolbar version text ("v0.0.0" painted where "v0.15.0 · test" is expected). That is build-environment dependent, and this PR does not touch the version code, so I am treating it as unrelated. I did not build the pre-PR main to confirm.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The author's PR text lists no hands-on check. The GUI was not launched in this review either, so the layout is verified only by the headless test.
- `docs/decisions/` has no file for #509, and the diff adds none. Add one if a decision was taken here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
